ordered_diagnoses: Pelvic inflammatory disease due to HIV-negative status

facts.raw_span: a 3-day history of nausea, vomiting, and right lower-quadrant abdominal pain
urine human chorionic gonadotropin test was negative
a second abdominopelvic ultrasound was interpreted as suggestive of retrocecal appendicitis
a 15 × 6 cm cystic mass with regular margins was found arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex
a 3-day history of nausea, vomiting, and right lower-quadrant abdominal pain
urine human chorionic gonadotropin test was negative
a second abdominopelvic ultrasound was interpreted as suggestive of retrocecal appendicitis
a 15 × 6 cm cystic mass with regular margins was found arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex

concepts.why: A 15 × 6 cm cystic mass with regular margins was found arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex.
Purulent fluid was noted in the cystic mass arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex.
A second abdominopelvic ultrasound was interpreted as suggestive of retrocecal appendicitis.
Leukocyte count elevation and purulent fluid were noted, suggesting an infectious process.
Right lower abdominal quadrant tenderness and a cystic mass arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex were noted.
Right lower abdominal quadrant tenderness and leukocyte count elevation were noted.
A cystic mass arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex was noted, but urine human chorionic gonadotropin test was negative.
A cystic mass arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex was noted.

concepts.preferred_label: Pelvic inflammatory disease due to HIV-negative status
concepts.why: The negative HIV testing result explains the lower likelihood of immunocompromised conditions.

rationales.F01: Nausea, vomiting, and right lower-quadrant abdominal pain are non-specific symptoms.
rationales.F03: Afebrile status reduces the likelihood of infectious processes.
rationales.F08: Negative urine human chorionic gonadotropin test rules out ectopic pregnancy.
rationales.F09: HIV-negative status reduces the likelihood of HIV-related conditions.
rationales.F11: The presence of a cystic mass with regular margins arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex is highly suggestive of an ovarian cyst.
rationales.F12: The presence of purulent fluid is highly suggestive of an infectious process, such as a tubo-ovarian abscess.

frontier_selector.rationale: The presence of a 15 × 6 cm cystic mass with regular margins arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex and purulent fluid noted upon incision of the cyst wall strongly supports the diagnosis of Tubo-ovarian abscess.
